entries.description: Manipulating an agent's goals, plans or decision path, e.g. through injected instructions

entries.description: Agents using legitimate tools in unsafe or unintended ways

entries.name: Agent Identity & Privilege Abuse
entries.description: Exploiting delegated identities, credentials and excessive privileges

entries.name: Unexpected Code Execution
entries.description: Agent-generated or agent-triggered code execution leading to compromise

entries.name: Memory & Context Poisoning
entries.description: Corrupting stored memory, RAG data or context that shapes future behavior

entries.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
entries.description: Unauthenticated or unencrypted agent-to-agent messages enabling spoofing and manipulation

entries.name: Cascading Failures

entries.name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
entries.description: Exploiting users' trust in agents, e.g. with fabricated justifications

entries.name: Rogue Agents
entries.description: Agents deviating from intended behavior without active attacker control

entries.name: AI Supply Chain Compromise
entries.description: Adversaries may gain initial access to a system by compromising the unique portions of the AI supply chain.

entries.name: Evade AI Model
entries.description: Adversaries can Craft Adversarial Data that prevents an AI model from correctly identifying the contents of the data or Generate Deepfakes that fools an AI m...

entries.name: Manipulate AI Model
entries.description: Adversaries may directly manipulate an AI model to change its behavior or introduce malicious code.

entries.name: Publish Poisoned Datasets
entries.description: Adversaries may Poison Training Data and publish it to a public location.

entries.name: Poison Training Data
entries.description: Adversaries may attempt to poison datasets used by an AI model by modifying the underlying data or its labels.

entries.name: Exfiltration via AI Inference API
entries.description: Adversaries may exfiltrate private information via AI Model Inference API Access.

entries.name: Infer Training Data Membership
entries.description: Adversaries may infer the membership of a data sample or global characteristics of the data in its training set, which raises privacy concerns.

entries.name: Extract AI Model
entries.description: Adversaries may extract a functional copy of a private model.

entries.name: Exfiltration via Cyber Means
entries.description: Adversaries may exfiltrate AI artifacts or other information relevant to their goals via traditional cyber means.

entries.name: Denial of AI Service
entries.description: Adversaries may target AI-enabled systems with a flood of requests for the purpose of degrading or shutting down the service.

entries.name: Cost Harvesting
entries.description: Adversaries may deliberately drive a victim's AI services beyond normal operating capacity with the intent of increasing the cost of services.

entries.name: AI Model Inference API Access
entries.description: Adversaries may gain access to a model via legitimate access to the inference API.

entries.name: Verify Attack
entries.description: Adversaries can verify the efficacy of their attack via an inference API or access to an offline copy of the target model.

entries.name: Craft Adversarial Data
entries.description: Adversarial data are inputs to an AI model that have been modified such that they cause the adversary's desired effect in the target model.

entries.name: Full AI Model Access
entries.description: Adversaries may gain full "white-box" access to an AI model.

entries.name: AI-Enabled Product or Service
entries.description: Adversaries may use a product or service that uses artificial intelligence under the hood to gain access to the underlying AI model.

entries.name: LLM Prompt Injection
entries.description: An adversary may craft malicious prompts as inputs to an LLM that cause the LLM to act in unintended ways.

entries.name: AI Agent Tool Invocation
entries.description: Adversaries may use their access to an AI agent to invoke tools the agent has access to.

entries.name: LLM Jailbreak

entries.name: Extract LLM System Prompt
entries.description: Adversaries may attempt to extract a large language model's (LLM) system prompt.

entries.name: LLM Data Leakage
entries.description: Adversaries may craft prompts that induce the LLM to leak sensitive information.

entries.name: Publish Poisoned Models
entries.description: Adversaries may publish a poisoned model to a public location such as a model registry or code repository.

entries.name: RAG Poisoning

entries.name: AI Agent Context Poisoning
entries.description: Adversaries may attempt to manipulate the context used by an AI agent's large language model (LLM) to influence the responses it generates or actions it takes.

entries.name: Govern
entries.description: Cultivate a culture of risk management

entries.name: Map
entries.description: Context and risk identification

entries.name: Measure
entries.description: Analyze, assess, and track AI risks

entries.name: Manage
entries.description: Allocate resources to mapped and measured risks
